exploration.title: Ten-Minute Certainty
openQuestions: Coverage Regression: stay non-required but gating Yeet mergeable (recommended now, with a fixed context name), become a required context, or stop gating mergeable?

Canonical citation corpus replays (Test Integration at the real 30 s extractDeadline): full replay on every PR (recommended until #3005 steady state and main verdicts are measured), or a smoke subset per PR plus the full replay nightly or on main?

Property Laws: is +6 to +10 runner-min per run worth about 3.4 min off the Yeet-mergeable tail? Recommended: the property file split first, shard only if p95 stays over 10 min and the target is ruled to cover mergeable contexts.

Heavy / Lint Policy: keep it on the cap-2 heavy pool with the diet (recommended; standard hosted runners are refuted at 32-36 GiB peaks), or open a capacity decision (money) after the post-diet queue p95 is measured?

A verdict for every main commit: staged (ban manual main cancels via an AGENTS.md amendment, then a throughput layout, then per-SHA groups; recommended) versus per-SHA full profile now (20-36k runner-min/day) versus coalesced verdicts?

Review window: should a push that leaves the PR's own patch-id unchanged (a clean merge of origin/main) re-arm the 20-minute window? Recommended: no re-arm; a conflict touching PR lines still re-arms.
The #2999 docs-only widening: targeted narrowing through a generated goal-data consumer census plus a docs-policy job (recommended), full rollback, or keep as is?

Does the 10-minute target count non-required contexts that gate Yeet mergeable (Lint Policy, Property Laws, Coverage Regression, Fallow), and is it computed over code heads only with red and held heads counted as misses (recommended)?
Is `yeet verify --merged` (merged-preview, weight 5, no grants since early October) still a supported proof posture (recommended: supported, marked dormant) or may it be retired?
Does the 2026-11-08 R2 workstation-writer pause bind this plan's cache-reuse levers (TURB-05, TURB-10, YEET-05)?
time-to-certainty is paused: un-pause it, or re-home its open seams (ProofLedger C4.2 enforcement, WaveOrder re-seed, gate-order fixtures) into this packet's goals?
May detached readiness monitors back off to 2-5 minutes in push-blocked states, and must agents budget the shared REST token across monitors, the nightly scorecard and corpus capture?
May economics pull attempt journals from fleet hosts and include T3 lanes by default, with seat and host fields on attempt rows?
Push-first D1/D2: may a bounded advisory direct-owner coverage run execute inside publish before the push, given D2 rejects detached advisory proofs?
